channel.title: KORTEX Blog
channel.description: Practical articles on Generative Engine Optimization, AI answer engines and entity-first content, and how one source becomes a month of cited content.

item.title: A practical guide to answer engine visibility
item.description: Answer engine visibility means being cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini. Learn how they pick sources and the content architecture that earns citations.

item.title: How to build a category in the age of AI search.
item.description: Category creation in AI search means publishing a precise, retrievable definition before ChatGPT or Perplexity writes one for you. A 4-phase B2B playbook.

item.title: The B2B content audit framework for AI retrieval readiness.
item.description: A GEO content audit scores every page on 5 criteria AI answer engines reward, then sorts it into keep, retrofit or retire. Framework, scorecard and checklist.

item.title: Entity-first content: the architecture AI search rewards.
item.description: Entity-first content builds one consistent knowledge graph that ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini can cluster and cite. The 5 components, linking rules and schema.

item.title: Why most B2B LinkedIn content dies in 48 hours.
item.description: B2B LinkedIn posts fade within two days because they are published as one-off activity. How to link each post to answer pages that keep working for months.

item.title: The new B2B content stack: video, entities, answers, distribution.
item.description: The B2B content stack in four layers: raw signal, entities, answer assets, distribution. How to run each, which AI tools to use, and why the old stack fails.

item.title: From one video to 30 days of content AI engines can cite
item.description: Turn one video into 30 days of linked content: pillar article, FAQ page, comparison page and LinkedIn posts. The extraction method, step by step.

item.title: Ranking is not enough. Become the source AI answers cite.
item.description: GEO vs SEO explained: how to structure B2B content so ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini cite your company as the source, with a five-step page framework.
